title: Cliff as a character, his clothes and bootlegging; their marriage
summary: A subtly funny man with Stetson hats and Box Back suits; they married in 1950.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Was he something of a character?

Yeah, he was -- but in a very, very subtle sort of way. Cliff never had very much to my, but every time he said something, it was a gem, you know, he was one of those kind, he was very wise and of course he'd been around a lot, he'd seen a lot and as I said before, he started out very young as a pianist and I think when he was about 15 or 16 he was somewhat of a big shot down in Washington, D.C., doing whatever -- he said he had a Stutz-Bearcat automobile when he was 15 years old. So he evidently --
Yes, definitely and Box Back suits and the Stetson hats, that thing, so I guess
